events.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) published a notice inviting public comment on a proposed information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. The collection will gather data on residential care communities (RCCs) and adult day services centers (ADSCs) as part of the 8th National Post-Acute and Long-Term Care Study (NPALS). Data will be collected from approximately 4,399 providers across 50 states and D.C., covering provider characteristics, staffing, services, and resident/participant demographics and health conditions.
